Innovation Hub: Student Showcase
Celebrate breakthrough ideas at our campus-wide Student
Showcase! Explore hands-on demonstrations, poster galleries,
and enlightening talks from undergraduate and graduate student
researchers across AI, sustainability, health, the arts, and public
policy. Discover projects with real-world impact, meet potential
collaborators, and learn about funding, internships, and
mentorship opportunities.
Date & Time: Wednesday, April 16, 4:00–7:30 P.M.
Location: Innovation Hub Atrium
Audience: Students, faculty, staff, alumni, and
community partners
Highlights: People’s Choice Award, industry judges,
networking, and refreshments
Presenting? Submit a 250-word abstract by March 25 at
www.wexmorecollege.edu/innovationhub.
Attending? RSVP by April 10. Admission is free.
Accommodations are available: please note accessibility needs
when you RSVP.
Questions? Send requests for information to
innovationhub@wexmorecollege.edu by April 15.
